description: No assessment has been conducted to determine whether personal data transfers to third countries or international organizations comply with GDPR requirements. Article 44 establishes general principles for transfers.
applicability: Applicable to all transfers of personal data to third countries or international organizations, regardless of processing location or transfer mechanism.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of data flows, vendor locations, and absence of transfer impact assessments or legal basis documentation.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter V - Transfers to Third Countries
